rows: College page lists Physics/Chemistry with Biology and Mathematics; or Biology with Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Microbiology/Home Science/Computer Science; or Botany and Zoology. sections.heading: Minimum eligibility and closing rank answer different questions
paragraphs: A qualifying subject or minimum academic threshold determines whether an applicant can be considered under the applicable rules. A closing rank or score describes a particular selection list, counselling round or category. One should not be substituted for the other.
